pose: extended (head bottom z=27, hinge axis z=16.5) unless stated; rest = -20; neck halves CLOSED as built/exported (front y -10..0, back 0..10)
reuse_note: sections 2-4 come from the full round-5 run (checks_run_r5.log, 4568 s) of the same geometry; only the head cross-screw heads changed afterwards (ISO 7380 dk 3.5) and they take no part in 2-4

nonzero_pairs.shell x lug_plus: 0.091 (R3: 3 crush ribs (0.05) per apron-peg hole grip the D2 pegs (friction hold, removable))
nonzero_pairs.cap x horn: 0.177 (4 crush ribs 0.1 on the arm flanks (intended press, zero backlash))

skipped_pairs.horn-servo: horn is ON the spline (turns with the shaft)
skipped_pairs.cable_head-cable_neck: same wire bundle, joint ON the hinge axis (pure twist)

4_tilt_allowed_vs_lift.firmware: R3 rule: between two listed lifts use the value of the MORE RETRACTED one (step, no interpolation); full +-40 only at full extension; below -17.5 (to rest -20) tilt 0

6_walls.note: voids clipped off the hinge-mouth slabs 17.3<=|x|<=18.7 (r<=10.6); outside = neck exterior minus the bottom face zone (z<ZB+1.5) and the hinge-gap mouths r<=8.5 (counterbore / hub bore open there by design); screw counterbores + clearance holes are open to the front face by design (always inside the torso)

7_assembly.4_note: values at s<=2.1 include only the intended crush-rib contact on the 2 apron pegs (0.09 mm3 at s=0)

neck_surface_openings.where: hinge-gap end face (hidden by the lug, 0.5 gap)
hinge-gap end face (hidden by the lug, 0.5 gap)

collar_slot_open_strips_at_rest.note: seams only: 0.25 slot clearance, 0.5 radial apron-knuckle gap, 0.5 lug-knuckle gaps

seam_zbuffer.method: orthographic z-buffer of all parts (0.05 mm/px, window |x|<=25 around the hinge), neck parting gap closed; internal = servo, horn, MR85, pins, screws, cables

9_cable.route: neck bottom -> chamber x12.0..14.6 beside the servo end face -> up through the pin's -Z end slot 1.8 x 2.5 -> static bend R1.5 inside the pin bore D3 -> joint ON the axis x18.4 (only twists) -> rotating bend R1.8 inside the lug chamber x18.5..21.3 -> lug channel D1.6 x20.5 (tilted to x20.3 in the tenon) -> tenon top -> display

10_servo_hold.servo_hard_stop_rock_deg: <= 0.15 (foam preload takes up the play below)
10_servo_hold.horn_free_rock_deg: 0 (arms pressed between 4 crush ribs, 0.1 per flank)
10_servo_hold.round2: pocket = case -> 51 mm3 interference with the halves closed (rejected); round1 +-1.15 deg

neck_clamp.note: no interference left between the closed halves (only the foam preload pushes them apart, centroid z 4.6, between the screw lines z -10.5 .. 5.6)

pin_grip.bond: epoxy (or Loctite 603 + SF 7649 activator), radial bond gap 0.05-0.06 (R5 corrected)

apron_pegs.apron_top_to_head_gap: 0.1 (not glued: the head must lift off vertically for service)
apron_pegs.note: apron = beam fixed at the +X lug and held near the -X tip by a D2 peg gripped by 3 crush ribs in the head floor (X/Y located, Z held by friction) -> no free cantilever

design_numbers.arm_slot: 5.0 wide, bottom x -20.15 (R5 +0.5) + 4 crush ribs r0.35, 0.1 interference over x -18.25..-19.95 (lead-in from the mouth)

cross_screws.head: R5: ISO 7380 M2 dk 3.5 x k 1.1 (axes 4.0 apart -> 0.5 between heads; a dk 4.0 pan head would touch)

design_numbers.torque_path: spline -> horn hub -> 2 arms pressed between crush ribs -> cap -> tenon 4x16 in head slot + 2 cross screws
design_numbers.visor: transfer tape 0.10 / 0.15 / 0.20 chosen after measuring the bond-line gap (nominal 0.1, montaz 18e); display preload via 4 foam pads 3 x 3 (<= 0.72 N)

13_stl_watertight.note: CELOK_* = concatenation of the closed per-part meshes; edges shared by touching parts (e.g. insert in its hole) are counted there, each part block itself is closed

2_saddle_land.note: flat black under the lug barrel (black lug above) - no opening; seen from the front the lug barrel surface fills the 1.8 mm taller strip

5_display_preload.r5_note: R5: the frame was replaced by 4 corner pads 3 x 3 (gasket() -> area above); see 16_round5.1
5_display_preload.spec: R4: frame 1.0 wide (outer edge of the LCD border), closed-cell PU foam (PORON type, soft grade), free 0.3 mm (gap 0.2 -> 33 %); 0.4 mm only if the measured gap is 0.25-0.3 (-> 33-38 %); foam must compress by >= 1/3 under <= 20 kPa (press test: 0.8 kg on a 20 x 20 mm piece) -> preload <= 5.5 N, display weight ~0.5 N
5_display_preload.load_path: foam -> visor -> 0.1 tape in uniform tension (flange bears on the rim)
5_display_preload.tape: R5: 93010LE / 93015LE / 93020LE chosen from the measured bond line (16_round5.1); the 30 kPa figure is the static-shear TEST load, not an allowable - R5 keeps the permanent tension <= 3.6 kPa

6_dowels_pin_service.pin_spec: R5: Ø5 h6 hardened linear shaft cut to 5.7, drilled Ø3 on a lathe (soft core), lapped to 4.985-4.990; or precision stainless tube 5.0 x 1.0 (OD +-0.01) lapped the same way; slip test with the actual MR85
6_dowels_pin_service.bond: epoxy on the FRONT-half seat only, back-half seat waxed (release) -> the back half lifts off with both dowels

7_model_consistency.spline: 20T -> horn indexes in 18 deg steps: use the spline position nearest vertical, trim the rest (<= +-9 deg) as the firmware centre offset

15_raycast_walls.method: per-part STL (rest pose, reported in the EXTENDED pose: z+20 for neck/head parts), 15000 area-weighted samples, ray along -normal, wall = first hit with opposite normal (dot < -0.7), rays > 3 mm ignored; head shell sampled only in the hinge/pad zone |x|<=32, |y|<=14, z HZ-1.5..HZ+12

known_below_1p2.krk_*_polovica x 15.8..16.0, r 2.55..3.1: MR85 inner-ring stop step: a 0.2 mm high ring on the solid counterbore floor (its radial width 0.5 is measured, not a wall; it only carries the inner-ring axial contact, 9.8 mm2)

1_visor_tape_major.rule: foam press test: 20 x 20 piece compressed by 1/3 under <= 0.8 kg (<= 20 kPa) -> pads 3 x 3; 0.8-1.6 kg (<= 40 kPa) -> pads 2 x 2; harder foam -> do not use

rule.t < 0.07 or between the bands: sand the spigot back face (glass plate P600 -> P1500, re-polish) into the next band above

bond_line.tape_compression: 0-0.03 -> wet-out under the 50 N press, the flange still seats
bond_line.measure: Plastigauge red (0.051-0.152) / blue (0.102-0.229) at 4 points, or depth gauge R - L (0.01)

walls.lead_channel_to_head_chamber: joined (same void, x 12.0-12.25) as in R4

2_mg90s_range_major.x_location: axial (X) position is set ONLY by the case end walls (0.15) and the horn in the cap; the tab slot leaves >= 0.3 on both sides of the nominal tab -> no over-constraint

3_horn_ribs.torque_cases: 0.021 gravity at 0 deg / 0.072 gravity at +40 deg / 0.19 = +40 deg + fast move (reviewer: 193 g head, I ~6e-4 kg m2, 200 rad/s2)

boss.note: boss +0.2 AND case pulled fully to -X: the boss top touches the end wall 0.05 before the case top reaches its stop (a contact, the servo floats axially) - no interference

4_servo_z.gravity_N: ~0.9 (about half of the 1.9 N head weight via the lower arm tip)
4_servo_z.note: the case far end rests on the pocket floor (Z datum -> spline on the hinge axis); upward it is held elastically by the two Y foam strips in shear (>= 16 N/mm) and by their friction (>= 2 N) plus gravity; the 0.15 at the roof only absorbs case-length tolerance

neck_screws.head: ISO 7045 (PH0) or ISO 14583 (T6) pan head, dk 4.0 / k 1.6 max - NOT DIN 912

dowels.fit: back half: ream D2.0 (resin prints undersize), dowel bonded with epoxy; front: D2.02 slip

lug_sleeve.fit: dry-fit by hand first; ream / sand the bore if the ring does not slide in

6_foam_shim.rule: case width < 12.15 -> one layer of 0.1 Kapton under each foam strip

left_side_hits_x_m51.verdict: mesh artifact: a long sliver facet of the cavity loft spans the 0.1 step from the rabbet floor edge (y -27.0) to the side display-rib corner (y -26.9); the B-rep material corner is ~82 deg (sections above) with the rabbet ring + 2 mm of wall behind it - not a thin wall (same hits in the round-4 STL; common head)
